reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, but parses days with new Date() instead of the months helpers and rewrites the daily-skip/adjust weekend decision inline rather than sharing it with getNextDate.

duplication.why: Copies getUpcomingDates' scaffolding (rules, RSchedule, try/captureBreadcrumb, skipWeekend branch) and restates getNextDate's daily-weekend skip rule, adding another copy of the weekend decision.

placement.why: A schedules app handler next to getUpcomingDates, as the tree does; the weekend decision would better sit in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear code, but the weekend rule now lives in several hand-maintained places and the ±3-day search window is an unexplained magic margin.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The weekend shift goes through getDateWithSkippedWeekend; no complete weekend-decision abstraction existed to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied getUpcomingDates structure and daily-skip condition in getDatesInRange are recognisable, not disguised.
